# A wrong password, exit code 12, and a repository that is not there, exit
# code 10.
$ restic --cache-dir /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache --cleanup-cache --no-lock check
--- stdout
using temporary cache in /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache/restic-check-cache-3503682859
--- stderr
Fatal: wrong password or no key found
--- exit 12
$ restic --cache-dir /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache --cleanup-cache --no-lock check
--- stdout
using temporary cache in /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache/restic-check-cache-3623436361
--- stderr
Fatal: repository does not exist: unable to open config file: stat /repo/config: no such file or directory
Is there a repository at the following location?
/repo
--- exit 10
